section_summary.extract_value: This section describes one study (Study X) that recruited 1,093 university students (568 men, 525 women) from seven universities in Tehran, Iran. Participants' ages ranged 18–50 (M = 25.87, SD = 4.66) and self-reported BMI ranged 16.14–36.07 (M = 23.69, SD = 3.48). The sample is college-based; no assessment instrument for body appreciation or correlations with BMI are reported.
